gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-atkinson-hyperl: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono has clipped capitals and counters that breathe into the white space, almost like stencil bridges pulled wide. Capture It stays nearly sealed and joined without any bulge, while the mono body lets every letter show itself.
Tight, towering and urban, Capture It barely lets its letters open. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next then loosens everything, with lowercase eyes big as washers and rounds left unlatched like a hook.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-biryani: Capture It towers, with a lowercase that nearly seals itself shut. Biryani sits beneath in a plain sans, every counter unclogged and every e wide-eyed, so text flows without a snag or a stroke that swells.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-blinker: Blinker holds its lines at a steady thickness, with open apertures and a lowercase that fills most of the height, under a tightly closed heading. Capture It supplies the sealed, towering punch.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic sets a high x-height and a generous opening in the c, a modern sans-serif counterweight to the nearly sealed Capture It. Text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-carrois-gothic-: Capture It is urban and commanding, its towering lowercase nearly sealed shut. Carrois Gothic SC opens every curve cleanly and keeps capitals close to lowercase height, so paragraphs read in a smooth, level line.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-chivo: Commanding and urban, Capture It towers over the line with its openings almost shut. But Chivo, a plain sans, packs its lowercase up toward the caps and lets daylight through every curve.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-chocolate-class: Capture It has a drawn-with-a-compass-pencil consistency and a towering lowercase, while Chocolate Classical Sans brings a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut. Body text can go a touch larger.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-comme: Urban and commanding, Capture It towers over a nearly sealed lowercase, while Comme keeps curves unclogged and lowercase bodies tall. A longer read goes smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-cossette-texte: Capture It brings towering, nearly sealed letters with no thick-thin flicker, built for impact. Cossette Texte is the plain sans that does the opposite job, with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height.
